I have been invited to participate in the podcast **Paroles d'Arts et Métiers** to discuss about my research in fluid dynamics, my experience as a Faculty member at Arts et Métiers and various other topics.
Although it is in French, you can find the episode [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEdsQ2K9gnY).
